Let me account for the 943 by batch and check for records labelled twice, then continue with the next packets.㊥ (gist) The 943 is real and comes from three batches over three days, with no record labelled twice. Continuing: the standings-index fix is done in-seat (963e05482), and the hyperedge carrier packet is with zai-2 under a park. Mission entry 6185dd622.

㊬ ("943 sidecars seems like more than I was expecting") The count by batch, checked against the files and their first commits:

| batch | directory | records | first committed |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | moves-scale | 158 | 2026-10-11 |
| 2 | moves-scale2 | 200 | 2026-10-11 |
| 3 | moves-scale3 | 585 | 2026-10-12 to 13 |

Batches 1 and 2 ran on 10-11 under your "64% of Zai to spend in 34 hours" remark; batch 3 was the four waves of 10-12 and 10-13, the last two on "we still have 8% of zai to use so please dispatch work accordingly". Distinct records: 943. The eligible pool, operator turns that were analysed and have a marked reply, is 1,103 today, so 160 remain unlabelled. For scale, the store holds 10,706 operator records, 1,523 of them with reply text. So the campaign labelled about 85% of what the sampler can see and about 9% of all operator turns.

㊢ (done in-seat) The standings index in `sample.py` now covers every turn record rather than only the sampled rows. A standing's opener usually lives in an agent reply or a bell, which the sampler never selects, so 286 of 489 standings in shard 10 had no text. One function, one test, 14 pass. Carve-out: I held the context and it was a few lines.

㊢ (dispatched) Carrier packet to zai-2: a script that reads the 943 sidecars and posts each answers entry as a `:xiang/answers` edge and each within or closes link as a `:xiang/scope` edge, with deterministic ids so relabelling re-puts the same edge, status proposed. Dry run only in the packet; I apply after review, to the :7093 scratch store where the follower's act edges already live, never :7073. Job `invoke-1792017092596-12567-4b5caf63`, park `park-e7d1008d-1d12-418a-bfac-21325427cb08`, deadline 45 minutes, running on zai-2 as of 22:31Z.

㊟ (the 160) They can be labelled in one more wave for about a point of the monthly meter, which now reads 1%. I have not sent that, since the question was whether 943 was already more than intended.
